author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Fan-favorite Star Wars character Mara Jade is apparently stuck in the non-canon Legends universe, as Lucasfilm apparently isn't ready—or doesn't want—to bring her back. Veteran Star Wars authors Claudia Grey and Timothy Zahn (who created Mara Jade in the 90s), have repeatedly asked Lucasfilm about finding a way to bring her into the new Disney-era canon, but they've been turned down. In other news, Karl Urban is having another banner year, with the highly-anticipated final season of The Boys set to premiere on Amazon, and a starring role as Johnny Cage in the Mortal Kombat sequel. But there's another adaptation he's ready to tackle: Red Dead Redemption. And finally, Ralph Fienness won't be returning as Lord Voldemort in the HBO Harry Potter series, but he does have a suggestion as to who should take up the noseless role, and it's a pretty good one.

#IGN #StarWars
title: The 90s Star Wars Character Lucasfilm Wants To Keep Frozen in Carbonite - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Dub Trailer for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime The Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea, an upcoming anime film distributed by Crunchyroll. Witness the next chapter of the franchise in That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime The Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea, in theaters in the United States and Canada on May 1.

After concluding the opening ceremony of the Demon Kingdom Federation Tempest, Rimuru and his companions are invited by the Celestial Emperor Elmesia of the great elven nation – the Magi Dynasty Thalion – to visit her private resort island. As the group enjoys their brief vacation, a mysterious woman named Yura appears. A new incident unfolds against the backdrop of the boundless azure sea.

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime The Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea's english dub cast stars Allegra Clark, Ryan Reynolds, Brittney Karbowski, Christopher Corey Smith, Yuri Lowenthal, Michelle Rojas, Tia Ballard, Amber Lee Connors, and more. The film is directed

description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Annulus, a free-to-play turn-based tactical RPG developed by Nirvana. title: Annulus - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Meet the voice cast of Mouse: P.I. for Hire in this latest trailer for the upcoming black and white first-person shooter game inspired by classic 1930s cartoons. Hear from the cast of Mouse: P.I. for Hire as they introduce you to their characters, provide insight into them and what inspired them, and give you a peek behind the scenes. The cast includes Troy Baker (voice of protagonist Jack Pepper), Camryn Grime (voice of Tammy Tumbler), Fred Tatasciore (voice of John Brown), Frank Todaro (voice of Cornelius Stilton), and Florian Clare (voice of Wanda Fuller). 

In Mouse: P.I. For Hire, join Private Investigator Jack Pepper as you clear the streets of Mouseburg from crooked cops and heavily armed gangs in order to get to the bottom of the corruption, kidnapping and murder plaguing the city.

Mouse: P.I. for Hire will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 16, 2026.

#ign #gaming
title: Mouse: P.I. for Hire - Official 'Meet The Cast' Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for The Pines, a psychological horror third-person RPG developed by Studio Abattoir. Players will embody a former detective named Edward Walker, who senses something sinister in a place of peace for those in need at The Pines retreat. Investigate clues, make use of the Stalker System that responds to choices and actions, and uncover the truth of The Pines. The Pines is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Pines - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Play as Charlie Disco, a fallen icon with one chance to reclaim the spotlight from the Idols – Charlie’s ex-bandmates and musical legends. Confront the Idols in stylish combat that syncs to every song, and survive a world torn apart by music, fame, and betrayal. Dead as Disco will be available in Early Access via PC on May 5, 2026.

Dead as Disco's music transcends boundaries! Rock out to our streamer safe original soundtrack or beat down to licensed bangers past and present. Not enough? Then bring your own killer tracks to the party with My Music! Convert any song in your music library into new game content quickly and easily.
title: Dead as Disco - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Ryan is joined by IGN's Community Lead, Jada Griffin, and the host of Nintendo Voice Chat, Logan Plant. The crew looks ahead to the rest of 2026 to see if there are any more surprises left from the big three console makers. Recent rumors and leaks about a Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and a new Star Fox game have given us pause to think that there's more up their sleeves than they've announced. Is it time for a new Persona game? Is the next Uncharted on the way? How about a follow-up to Halo Infinite? Plus we have last week's poll results and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com and Spotify.

#IGN #Gaming
title: 2026’s Biggest Unannounced Games from Nintendo, Sony, and Microsoft - Next-Gen Console Watch
